quotes.text: Think of sales accelerator as a guide beside your desk, not a robot taking your chair. It helps you spend less effort finding the work, leaving you more room to do the part only a person can do, listen, respond and build trust.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable framing of guided selling as support rather than replacement.

quotes.text: Predictive scoring sounds technical, but the idea is simple. It gives each lead a signal based on patterns in the sales data.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains predictive scoring in plain language.

quotes.text: You can change the wording, choose a different action or pause the sequence when it no longer fits. The sequence keeps the process on track, but the rep owns the conversation.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies that sequences guide follow-up while the seller stays in charge.

quotes.text: Keep sequences simple at first because a long and rigid plan can create more work than it removes. Start with the few actions your team already knows work, then adjust after people have used them with real customers.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical rollout advice for sales sequences.

quotes.text: An AI-generated summary can help you spot the main points, but you still need to check it against the actual customer record.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear guidance on reviewing AI summaries before customer conversations.

takeaways: Sales Accelerator is a guided workspace inside Dynamics 365 Sales that turns a large pool of CRM records into a practical daily work list.
The Up next work list uses predictive scoring, company rules and recent activity to surface priorities, while sequences provide repeatable follow-up steps.
Customer context and AI summaries support preparation, but sellers still own the conversation, and sequence capacity depends on the Sales Enterprise or Premium license.
hook: Sellers juggle inboxes, calendars, CRM records and reminders and still miss the leads that matter most. This Simply Explained episode shows sales teams and managers how Dynamics 365 Sales Accelerator, with its Up next work list, sequences and customer context, brings focus and repeatable follow-up to the daily sales routine.
